mentions.name: Epub word-mirroring scripts
mentions.description: Scripts that mirror the words of an epub so the reader types along with the book, helping maintain focus while reading.
mentions.problem: Typing an entire book to keep the mind engaged while reading is too tedious.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wrote a few scripts to mirror the words on an epub, which does help with focus but isn't quite good enough.

evidence.value: I wrote a few scripts to mirror the words on an epub, which does help with focus but isn't quite good enough.
